children: Falcon Finance has scheduled its FF supply unlock for September 2027. The release covers about 203.06 million FF, an amount equal to 5.73% of the circulating supply. The tokens are allocated to the ecosystem, the foundation, investors and the team.
Once unlocked, the tokens become available to sell. Sales from any of the recipient groups could add selling pressure to the FF market.

title: Falcon Finance: Unlocks About 203.06 Million FF - Sep 2027
